journey: Arrive on home page, pass age gate

expected: Line and total update.

what_i_did: Compared Alien OG - Smalls prices on search card, product page, bag and checkout.
what_happened: Card $79.41 = PDP $79.41 = bag line $79.41 = checkout line $79.41 = checkout subtotal $79.41; taxes 7.54+13.04 -> To Pay $99.99 in bag and checkout (math correct). But the sticky bag bar shows $99.99 right after adding a $79.41 item with no 'incl. tax' label; the PDP/cards never mention that ~26% tax is added.

what_happened: Logout clears session and returns home; /profile redirects to /login?from=%2Fprofile; password login succeeds and returns to home (not back to the page I came from).
expected: Logout/login work.

what_i_did: /forgot-password (empty submit, then test email) -> email 'Request to reset password' -> opened link -> saved new password -> logged in with new, old rejected.
what_happened: Empty: 'Please enter email or phone number'. Request: 'Instructions for reset password sent to ...' + 'Reset link sent successfully'. Email arrived in <30 s from info@curecompany.com. The link's href has no https:// scheme (www.thecurecompany.com/reset-password?passwordToken=...), so it had to be opened manually. New password worked, old rejected. The same link then accepted a second new password (link not single-use; token has no exp claim).
expected: Working clickable https link; link single-use and expiring.

what_i_did: Footer 'JOIN VIP LIST' (opens lab.alpineiq.com/join/c/4413/109731 in a new tab) and the auto pop-up; submitted empty to see validation only.
what_happened: Only newsletter on the site is AlpineIQ 'Sign Up For VIP Deals': Mobile Phone, Favorite Store and a drawn Signature are required, email optional, and the consent covers autodialed texts/calls. No email-only option; account profile has no newsletter toggle. Empty submit: 'This field is required' x5 and a 'You must agree to the terms and conditions' toast (consent checkbox sits below the Sign Up button). Not submitted: needs a real mobile number + SMS consent; no test phone was provided.
expected: Email-only newsletter option that the test inbox can confirm.
